summary: The PR fixes a critical bug in the POSIX lock implementation but introduces potential regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The change may introduce behavioral regressions by altering the return values of lock and unlock functions, which could affect existing code relying on the previous behavior.
There are no new tests added to verify the correctness of the changes, leaving the fix unverified and potentially vulnerable to future regressions.
The code readability is slightly reduced due to the addition of try-except blocks, which could make the code harder to understand for future maintainers.
